answer_1.quote: Generating a span of missing tokens in a text chunk, known as 'text infilling,' has attracted many attentions recently . Here we study the related but somewhat different task of 'sentence infilling.' Specifically, as illustrated in Figure , intermediate sentences (or chunks of text) are removed from long-form text... and the task is to generate the missing pieces that can smoothly blend into and fit the context...
answer_1.outputs: Generated intermediate sentences to fill gaps in long-form text

answer_2.quote: We perform automatic evaluation using standard machine translation metrics, including BLEU, NIST, and METEOR. ... We also use Entropy and Dist-n to evaluate lexical diversity.

answer_4.quote: We performed human evaluation of our method on the TripAdvisor dataset. We used a crowd evaluation platform to compare two systems and assess their fluency, informativeness, and relevance to the surrounding context (coherence) on 500 random samples from the test set.
answer_4.guideline: Judges assessed fluency, informativeness, and coherence using a crowd evaluation platform.
